Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner at step 3 fails to recognize that the search for "Pleshkovo" will reveal multiple countries, leading to redundant verification loops for Tomskoye in subsequent steps. Evidence: Steps 10-12 show the search for "Pleshkovo village country Russia" revealing results in both Russia (Altai Krai) and Poland; subsequent steps (13-19) involve the Planner synthesizing this to form the final conclusion.
